comment: The bill identity total = subtotal - discount + tax + rounding is written in
three places: billTotals() in src/domain/billing.ts, the check constraints on
orders and bills, and billing_validate_totals in SQL. A drift between them does
not fail a test on its own - it refuses live bills at the counter.
So this is the one table of cases all three are held to. It is consumed by
validator), and scripts/check-totals-cases.mjs fails the lint if the SQL copy
drifts from this file. Add a case here and the lint tells you the exact block
subtotal and discount are the inputs; rounding and total are what all three
must independently agree the answer is. Tax is nought throughout because v1 is
no_tax, and the column exists so that stops being true without a migration.
